candidates.explanation: Backlog-priority service protection with pipeline-aware relaxation. If backlog is present and pipeline is thin, add a small amount to restore service; if pipeline is excessive and backlog is zero, trim cautiously. Avoids growth-based triggers due to delayed block mean noise.

rules.when: backlog > 0 and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
pipeline > 2 * recent and backlog >= 1 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Conservative backlog-service coordination. Increase orders only when backlog is large and pipeline is very thin; reduce only when pipeline clearly exceeds demand and backlog is zero. Small deltas limit overreaction.

rules.when: backlog > 2 * recent and pipeline < 1.5 * recent and recent > 0
backlog > 0 and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware damping with downstream protection. When pipeline is high relative to recent demand, reduce orders modestly only if backlog is low; when pipeline is low and backlog exists, boost to protect service. Guards prevent division by zero and keep corrections bounded.

rules.when: pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog < 1 and recent > 0
pipeline < recent and backlog > 0 and recent > 0
pipeline > 2 * recent and backlog >= 1 and recent > 0
